nodes.label: Analyse approfondie des CRM existants (CRM e-commerce algerien)
Score global de fiabilite par numero de telephone
nodes.rationale: Core product idea: behavioural COD reliability score keyed on normalized phone number; no generalist CRM covers it.

nodes.label: Bureau de credit du paiement a la livraison (reseau de donnees)
nodes.rationale: Real product is a data network; value grows with contributors (network effect), not UI. CRM is the Trojan horse to collect data.

nodes.label: Demarrage a froid (cold start)
nodes.rationale: Score without history is useless; mitigated by immediate individual value for the seller and pilot history import.

nodes.label: Piege du perimetre tout HubSpot + Salesforce
nodes.rationale: Cloning full HubSpot/Salesforce is out of reach and does not solve phone reliability for COD.

nodes.label: Multi-tenancy : quatre modeles (colonne tenant_id, schema par tenant, base par tenant, cellules/pods)
Base partagee + colonne tenant_id + Row-Level Security PostgreSQL
nodes.rationale: Recommended start: cheapest per tenant; design a tenant routing key from day one to move to cells later.

nodes.label: Monolithe modulaire + service de scoring separe
nodes.rationale: Small team, modest traffic, need fast iteration; scoring isolated because lifecycle, security and legal risks differ.

nodes.label: Plan reseau (donnees pseudonymisees partagees)
nodes.rationale: Isolated shared plane; HMAC pseudonymization; banded outputs, never raw counters, to limit legal risk, enumeration and leakage.

nodes.label: Plan tenant (donnees privees du vendeur, RLS)
Pseudonymisation par HMAC (cle secrete KMS)
nodes.rationale: Plain SHA-256 of a phone number anonymizes nothing: small number space is brute-forceable.

nodes.label: Estimation bayesienne Beta-Binomiale avec decroissance temporelle
nodes.rationale: Explainable, stable with little data, defensible before authority and contesting client; k between 8 and 20 as prior strength.

nodes.label: Niveau 3 : modele hierarchique multi-facteurs (regression logistique calibree)
nodes.rationale: Separates client, seller and carrier effects so refusals caused by seller/courier are not blamed on the customer.

nodes.label: Statuts transporteurs comme source de verite (livre/refuse/injoignable)
nodes.rationale: Without external proof the network is poisonable by malicious sellers.

nodes.label: Normalisation des numeros algeriens vers E.164 (05/06/07)
nodes.rationale: A normalization error fragments history and mechanically degrades score quality; use libphonenumber.

nodes.label: Signaux mesurables (refus, injoignable, decroche, delai de reponse, livraison encaissee, diversite vendeurs)
Bandes de score (vert/orange/rouge/inconnu) + codes de raison
API de scoring (p99 < 150 ms)
nodes.rationale: Scoring API is an oracle: without strong auth, quotas, logging and bands it becomes an enumeration and personal data leak tool.

nodes.label: Workflows en machines a etats explicites (confirmation, mise a jour du score)
RBAC par tenant + journal d'audit append-only
Chiffrement par champ + index aveugle HMAC
Colonnes JSONB indexees pour champs personnalises
nodes.rationale: Typed columns for everything central to scoring; JSONB only for seller custom fields; score never depends on free field.

nodes.label: Pile technologique proposee (NestJS/Django, PostgreSQL, Redis, NATS, ClickHouse, FastAPI, Keycloak)
Modele de donnees minimal (tenants, customers, orders, shipments, phone_identity, outcome_events, phone_score)
Estimation de charge (600 000 commandes/jour, ~104 evts/s)
nodes.rationale: A properly sized PostgreSQL with read replicas and Redis handles this; real challenges are carrier integration reliability, data quality, scoring API security.

nodes.label: Feuille de route en 5 phases (Fondations -> Largeur CRM)
Questions restant a trancher (CRM ou score ? source de verite ?)
Pipedrive
nodes.rationale: Lesson: seller opens CRM to know which orders to call now and which risk returning; main screen = risk-prioritized work queue.

nodes.label: Odoo
nodes.rationale: Database-per-client model incompatible with thousands of low-ARPU sellers.

nodes.label: Twenty CRM
nodes.rationale: Good model for metadata layer; bad model for tenancy at thousands of sellers.

nodes.label: SuiteCRM / EspoCRM / Vtiger
nodes.rationale: First-gen open source CRMs fail on dated UX, volume performance and core-modification extensibility; avoid forking.

nodes.label: Antifraude / reputation (Sift, Riskified, Signifyd, Ekata, Telesign, Truecaller)
Positionnement : le score COD pense pour l'Algerie
Lacune : prediction de retours COD et identite globale par telephone absentes des CRM generalistes
ANPDP (Autorite nationale de protection des donnees)
Partage inter-vendeurs = profilage inter-responsables (risque juridique majeur)
Consequences de conception (minimisation, limitation de duree, transparence, contestation, explicabilite)
Taxonomie des CRM (operationnel, analytique/CDP, collaboratif, antifraude, e-commerce)

hyperedges.label: Concurrents score de risque / blacklist COD
Cadre juridique algerien de protection des donnees
